name: irrigation_scheduling
description: rule used to decide when and how much to irrigate
notes: replaces the provisional irrigation_scheduling_ in doi_10.7910_DVN_U9MZZV

name: irrigation_interval
description: number of days between irrigation events

name: irrigation_duration
description: average duration of one irrigation event

name: irrigation_start_time
description: start time of an irrigation event
notes: CGIAR minimum variable; one row per event, with the event date in date

name: irrigation_end_time
description: end time of an irrigation event
notes: CGIAR minimum variable

name: irrigation_flow_rate
description: discharge rate of the pump or pipe used for irrigation
notes: CGIAR minimum variable; L/s x 3.6 = m3/h

name: soil_moisture_before
description: soil moisture status of the plot before irrigation
notes: CGIAR minimum variable

name: soil_moisture_after
description: soil moisture status of the plot after irrigation
notes: CGIAR minimum variable

name: irrigation_lifting
description: how irrigation water is lifted or delivered to the field
notes: the energy source is part of the value, e.g. diesel pump or solar pump

name: irrigation_source_distance
description: distance from the field to the source of irrigation water

name: irrigation_fuel
description: fuel used for pumping irrigation water per ha over the season
notes: as weeding_fuel

name: irrigation_electricity
description: electricity used for pumping irrigation water per ha over the season

name: pump_power
description: rated power of the irrigation pump

name: pump_hours
description: hours the pump was operated for this field over the season

name: field_water_depth
description: water level in the field relative to the soil surface; negative values are below the surface
notes: e.g. measured with a field water tube under alternate wetting and drying

name: waterlogging
description: Was the field waterlogged at some point during the season?

name: ETa
description: actual evapotranspiration of the crop between planting and harvest
notes: report how it was obtained in ETa_method

name: ETa_method
description: method used to obtain ETa, e.g. soil water balance, lysimeter, eddy covariance, or remote sensing such as WaPOR

name: ETc
description: crop evapotranspiration under standard conditions (ETo x Kc) between planting and harvest
notes: ETo in the weather group is daily

name: rain_effective
description: effective rainfall between planting and harvest
notes: rain is total rainfall

name: WP_ET
description: crop water productivity: yield per unit of water consumed (yield / ETa)
notes: same yield basis (fresh or dry) as yield

name: WP_irrigation
description: irrigation water productivity: yield per unit of irrigation water applied (yield / irrigation_amount)
notes: same yield basis (fresh or dry) as yield

name: WP_total
description: yield per unit of total water input (irrigation + rainfall)
notes: same yield basis (fresh or dry) as yield

name: well_type
description: type of well used as the water source

name: well_depth
description: depth of the well below the ground surface

name: groundwater_depth
description: depth to the groundwater table below the ground surface
notes: record the measurement date in date

name: irrigation_scheme
description: name of the irrigation scheme

name: irrigation_scheme_type
description: type of irrigation scheme, by who develops and manages it

name: wua_member
description: Is the household a member of a water users' association?

name: water_sample_type
description: type of water that was sampled

name: water_sample_depth
description: depth at which the water sample was taken, below the water surface (or the ground surface for wells)

name: water_temp
description: water temperature
notes: same unit as temp in the weather group

name: water_pH
description: water pH

name: water_EC
description: electrical conductivity of water
notes: uS/cm as in the CGIAR minimum variables and SDG 6.3.2; soil_EC uses mS/cm (1 mS/cm = 1000 uS/cm)

name: water_TDS
description: total dissolved solids

name: water_DO
description: dissolved oxygen

name: water_turbidity
description: turbidity

name: water_NO3
description: nitrate concentration, as NO3
notes: NO3-N x 4.427 = NO3

name: water_NOx
description: total oxidised nitrogen (nitrate + nitrite), as N
notes: CGIAR minimum variable and SDG 6.3.2 level 1 parameter

name: water_NH4
description: ammonium concentration, as NH4
notes: NH4-N x 1.288 = NH4

name: water_N_total
description: total nitrogen concentration

name: water_PO4
description: orthophosphate concentration, as PO4
notes: PO4-P x 3.066 = PO4; check whether the source reports as P

name: water_P_total
description: total phosphorus concentration

name: water_K
description: potassium concentration

name: water_Na
description: sodium concentration

name: water_Ca
description: calcium concentration

name: water_Mg
description: magnesium concentration

name: water_Cl
description: chloride concentration

name: water_SO4
description: sulfate concentration

name: water_HCO3
description: bicarbonate concentration

name: water_B
description: boron concentration

name: water_SAR
description: sodium adsorption ratio

name: water_BOD
description: biochemical oxygen demand (5-day)

name: water_COD
description: chemical oxygen demand

name: water_ecoli
description: Escherichia coli count

name: water_coliform_fecal
description: thermotolerant (fecal) coliform count

name: water_pesticide
description: name of the pesticide active ingredient that was measured
notes: use names from the herbicides, insecticides and fungicides value lists; usually in a long table with water_pesticide_conc

name: water_pesticide_conc
description: pesticide concentration; must be accompanied by water_pesticide
